lines.en: I crawl by arching and stretching.
My body is pale and soft.
I move along seams in the ground.
I cross a patch of damp soil.
I can't see. I go by feel.
I push forward segment by segment.
My body bends into a curve.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块石头，腐土的缝很窄。
lines.en: I squeeze around a stone; the rot-soil gap is narrow.
I stop and contract once.
I leave a trail on the ground.

lines.zh: 我钻到叶子底下，慢慢爬。
lines.en: I crawl under a leaf, slowly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地、一点一点地走
lines.en: I move slowly, bit by bit.
My head lifts, then lowers.
I change direction and crawl on.
I'm too soft to move fast.
I rub past a tree root.
I curl into a ball and stay still.
The soil is damp. Comfortable.

lines.zh: 我的身子一下一下地缩
lines.en: My body contracts in little pulses.
I can't hear much.
Something has walked over me.
I stay still and let it pass.
My skin is thin. One touch could tear it.
I slowly stretch out.
This patch of soil will do.
I feel the light changing.
I pull my head back in.
I'm waiting for the dark.
I'm cool; so is the soil.

lines.zh: 我一点一点挪到更深处
lines.en: I edge deeper, little by little.
It's very quiet all around.
I contract once more.
You crouch down, very close.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，也能感到你
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I feel you.
My body contracts.
Your shadow covers the soil.
I creep back a little.

lines.zh: 你不像要吃我，但也不像
lines.en: You don't look like you'd eat me. Nor not.
I raise my front half and prop myself up.
Do you mean to catch me now?
I burrow under the leaf.
Don't bring your foot down.
I can writhe, but not run.
Walk away and I'll come out.
Three points of pale grub, just wriggling.
My body is a little torn.
I burrow more frantically.
I writhe hard.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天动不了
lines.en: That left me unable to move for a while.
I slowly stretch out and try to crawl.
I'm covered in soil.
I curl up and wait for you to go.
One more touch and I'm finished.
I've nowhere else to hide.
I eat whatever's edible in the soil.
What is it you set down?
I can't smell it. Too far.
Back off a little and I'll come.
I crawl over slowly.
This is soft. I'll try a bite.
I'm not fussy in the least.
Anything to eat is good.
Don't watch. It makes me uneasy.
I'll go when I've eaten.
Anything turned up from soil I can eat.
This piece is a bit too dry.
I ease over that way.
Hold still and I'll come.
Better to eat than not.
I'll try a small bite.
You touched me and I curled up.

lines.zh: 我的身子被压扁了一点
lines.en: My body got a little squashed.
I slowly uncurl.
That made me writhe.
I push a little into the soil.
You stepped on soil, not me.

lines.zh: 我从你的指缝里滑出去
lines.en: I slide out between your fingers.
A little damp patch is left.

lines.zh: 我一弓一伸，挪到石缝里。
lines.en: I inch my way into a stone crack.
Don't squeeze. I'd break.

lines.zh: 这一片土里有不少我们
lines.en: There are many of us in this soil.
Two of us pressed together is warm.
I curl, and you curl.
We move slowly along.
It's safe here. Stay quiet.
The soil is loose enough to burrow.
If something comes, we both curl.
We stay still and it leaves.
A little deeper, both of us.
Then no one will see us.
I cover it with my body.
Too big. I can't swallow it.
I nibble a little of it.
The taste isn't bad at all.
I push it into the soil.
You dropped it. I found it.
I can't lift it, only push.
It jammed against a stone.
Never mind. I'll leave it.
I lie on it and cannot shift it.
I have no teeth and no sting.
If you grab me, I can only flee.
I push down into the soil.
The soil's too hard to go deep.
I curl under a stone.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，但知道你还在
lines.en: I can't see you, but I know you're there.
If I move, I'll be seen.
So I don't move at all.
Will you wait longer than I can?
I bury myself in the loose soil.
I make myself smaller.
Your shadow hasn't left.
I inch deeper.
There's a gap in the soil. I go in.
Can you hear me squirm?

lines.zh: 三点血的蛆，动一下都费劲。
lines.en: A three-health maggot strains to move.
I press flat to the soil.
You step; I slow down.
When you look away, I'll go.

lines.zh: 我把身体绷直，贴着土不动。
lines.en: I stretch flat and press still against the soil.

lines.zh: 我扭了一下，碰到你的手
lines.en: I squirm and touch your hand.
Lighter than a scratch.
Your finger flicks me away.
I roll twice in the soil.
Up again, I burrow sideways.

lines.zh: 我没有能伤到你的地方
lines.en: There's nothing on me that can hurt you.
I only want to get away.
But I don't even have legs.
Only arch and stretch, arch and stretch.
I butt your finger with my body.
I work my way up out of the soil.
A fresh damp trail on the ground.
I curl up and stay still first.
The soil here is loose.
I stretch out and test a direction.
So small, I can only crawl.
I head for the shade.
It's cooler down in the soil.
I crawl along, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我这么小一条，只敢在土里动。
lines.en: A worm this small only stirs in soil.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身子蜷得更紧
lines.en: Heat makes me curl even tighter.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬地上，软软地摊开
lines.en: I hit hard ground and spread out soft.
Water bloats me.
The blast throws me up out of the soil.
An arrow pins me to the ground.
That light burns and I curl up.
I grow softer, smaller.
Lightning strikes nearby and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 没有土，我什么也抓不住
lines.en: No soil. I can grip nothing.
